description: This Java class defines a custom JSP tag 'PageContentTag' used to dynamically retrieve and display page content based on a specified content code, integrating with the Spring framework's dependency injection and web context.

classes.name: PageContentTag
classes.description: A custom JSP tag for rendering page content dynamically based on a content code; interacts with Spring to autowire services and retrieves content to display.

methods.name: getContentCode
methods.description: Getter for the content code used to retrieve specific content block.

methods.name: setContentCode
methods.description: Setter for the content code used to retrieve specific content block.

methods.name: doStartTagInternal
methods.description: Core method invoked at the start of the JSP tag processing; performs dependency injection if needed, retrieves content, and outputs it.

methods.name: doEndTag
methods.description: Method invoked at the end of tag processing; returns EVAL_PAGE to continue page processing.
